video.title: Build an Emergency Kit, One Item per Payday

elements.content: only 53% of households stored three days of water.
Many of us mean to build an emergency kit.
Then the list feels too big, so we never start.
found 96% had three days of food,
but only 53% had three days of water.
One: start with water, about a gallon per person per day.
Two: add one shelf-stable food to your next shopping list.
Three: keep it all in one labeled bin.
and needs vary by household. Follow your local guidance.
Try it today: add one gallon of water to your shopping list.
